# Livecheck

> Live status of a specific product page, marketplace listing, or job posting, read from the page itself at call time. Pay per call in USDC on Base via x402. No account, no API key.

## When to use
- Before recommending or buying a product: is this listing still available?
- Before applying to a job: is this posting still open?
- Before scraping or storing a URL: is it still live?
- After search results (Google Shopping, job boards, scraped lists): which of these are stale?

Livecheck is not a search engine. Bring one specific item URL.

## Endpoints
- POST /v1/verify/job ($0.01) — is this specific job posting still open? body {"url"} → {status: live|closed|unknown, title, signals[], confidence}
- POST /v1/verify/listing ($0.01) — is this product listing still available or sold out? body {"url"} → same response
- POST /v1/verify ($0.01) — body {"url": "..."} → {status: live|closed|unknown, title, signals[], http_status, canonical_url, checked_at, confidence}
- POST /v1/check ($0.02) — one-shot condition on a page: status_change, keyword, text_diff, numeric_threshold (e.g. price below X)
- POST /v1/watch ($2.50) — 30-day watcher; signed HMAC webhook when the condition fires (HTTPS callback optional; omit it and pull GET /v1/watch/{id}/events with the owner token)
- POST /v1/watch/renew ($2.50) — extend an active watcher; body {"id":"wtc_..."}; owner token required in addition to payment
- POST /v1/confirm ($0.10) — did a lead/contact/application form submission land? intent: lead_submit | listing_published
- POST /v1/confirm/order ($0.25) — does the order exist? intent: order_placed
- GET /v1/receipt/{id} (free) — verify any signed receipt

## How to act on Verify
- live → proceed
- closed → drop it; tell the user it's no longer available
- unknown → login wall, JavaScript-only page, or bot block; report as unknown, don't guess

## Limits
- Reads HTML and HTTP status; does not run JavaScript
- POST /v1/verify, /v1/verify/job, and /v1/verify/listing return 503 with Retry-After when too many checks are already running, or when the payment processor times out or errors. 503 means you were not charged. Retry later; do not treat 503 as closed or unknown.
- POST /v1/verify and POST /v1/verify/job may also consult public job-board APIs for Ashby, Workday, Lever, and Greenhouse (no API key). A posting the API reports missing is closed. A posting the API lists is live when the page is live or a JavaScript-only shell (signal ats_api_listed). If the page looks closed and the API still lists it, the verdict is unknown. Timeouts and HTTP 5xx are not treated as closed. Bot-challenge pages stay unknown (challenge_page); Livecheck does not bypass Cloudflare or reCAPTCHA.
- Status means availability only, not legitimacy or fraud risk
- Never logs in, submits forms, or changes anything on the target site
